sources.beginner: Field 1 and 2 are hand-calcs (1 - 1500/7850; vertical hookload = air weight x buoyancy factor from the StringExplorer component table, StringExplorer.jsx:46-62). Fields 3-6 need the soft-string engine on the fixture wells at 1500 kg/m3: the NextGen StringExplorer has only a Well/View select and runs 1440 kg/m3, and the Suite Torque and Drag Studio lacks the fixture wells and prints hookload to 0.1 kN (TorqueDragStudio/components/AnalysisTab.jsx:56). Unobtainable today.
sources.intermediate: All six need engine runs at 1500 kg/m3 (rotate on bottom, back ream, slide, and the inverse friction solve). FrictionExplorer (panels/torquedrag/FrictionExplorer.jsx) has Well/Operation selects and a target-hookload box but no mud input; the Suite Studio prints torque to 10 N.m and side force to 0.1 N/m (TorqueDragStudio/services/tdExport.js:24-25). Unobtainable today.
sources.advanced: Buckling limits and sliding distance are closed forms taught in advanced m01/l03-l04 and m03/l02 (BucklingExplorer.jsx:56-61 prints EI and clearance to support them). Torsion utilization, wear depth and wall loss need a rotate-on-bottom run at 1500 kg/m3 and the two-entry schedule; the BucklingExplorer wear view takes only hours at 120 rpm and a wear factor at 1440 kg/m3 (BucklingExplorer.jsx:121-157). Unobtainable today.

fields.evidence: 1 - 1500/7850 = 0.808917197..., one division and one subtraction; the capstone lesson warns tol 5e-7 and says to carry the full division. StringExplorer prints the factor to 10 decimals at 1440 (StringExplorer.jsx:60), which is a method check, not a leak.

fields.display_ref: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/torquedrag/StringExplorer.jsx:52 (weight kg/m fmt 4 decimals); :61 air weight kN to 3 decimals; note at :73-74 prints the 1440 closed form to 6 decimals
fields.evidence: Buoyed weight = sum(weight x length) x 9.80665 x 0.808917197. From the component table's 4-decimal weights it is 725456.378, 0.38 N from 725456.759 (tol 0.5); from the air-weight tile (kN to 3 decimals) x BF the error is at most 0.40 N.
fields.notes: Passes, with little margin, from the printed table. The exact route is the full-precision 1440 closed form in the panel note scaled by BF1500/BF1440, which the lessons do not teach. The engine's 33.126528414 kg/m drill pipe weight is quoted in full in the advanced prompt only.

fields.display_ref: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/torquedrag/BucklingExplorer.jsx:56-61 (EI fmt 3 decimals, buoyed weight N/m 4, clearance 6; at 1440 and the well hole)
fields.evidence: Closed form 2 sqrt(EI w sin(inc) / r) taught in m01/l03 (its exercise supplies EI and w for the collars): EI from the pipe dimensions or the panel, w = 33.126528414 x 9.80665 x 0.808917197, r = (0.2159 - 0.127) / 2; full precision by hand.
fields.notes: The panel's own limit tile is at 1440 kg/m3, in kN to 3 decimals, so it cannot be read directly.

fields.evidence: Sinusoidal limit x (2 sqrt 2 - 1) as taught in m01/l04; full precision.
